d: SAROS IC4P-W Saros® 3 in. Passive Full-Range In-Ceiling Speaker, White, Textured

specs.label: Coverage
specs.value: 170° conical (speech, up to 4 kHz); 140° conical (music, up to 8 kHz)

specs.label: BMR Max Power Output
specs.value: 25 W, connected to an external amplifier via 2-pin audio input; 10 W, connected to the SPEAKER-LEVEL OUTPUT of a SAROS DM‑NAX‑IC4‑A; 6.5 W, connected to the SPEAKER-LEVEL OUTPUT of a SAROS DM‑NAX‑IC4‑A with one other SAR

specs.label: Enclosure
specs.value: Painted steel, plenum-rated; 0.75 in. (19 mm) conduit knockout on top and sides; (1) cable clamp included

specs.label: Grille
specs.value: Steel with white textured finish; Magnetically held; Safety tether included

specs.label: Mounting
specs.value: Flush ceiling mount using 4 integral 2-step toggle clamps; 2.36 in. (60 mm) maximum clamping thickness; 6.5 in. (165 mm) recommended cutout diameter; Tile bridge included

specs.value: 7.49 in. (191 mm) not including mounting clamps

specs.value: 6.33 in. (161 mm) not including mounting clamps
